entities.name: A0A0M4FTF3
observations: Reviewed Petunia hybrida blue copper protein; sequence is an exact 266-aa match.
Annotated as a single-pass type I membrane protein at the plasma membrane.
GO annotations include electron transfer activity and response to symbiotic fungus.
Two Cu_bind_like Pfam regions detected at residues 62–90 and 126–205.
